description: Fixed RepoSage Task 001 evaluation questions for the local DevPulse checkout. Expected locations were selected manually from code before retrieval tuning.

questions.question: How does DevPulse decide whether developer and repository data is still fresh before refreshing?

expected_locations.note: refreshDeveloper checks developer and repository sync keys before fetching and syncing.
CacheFreshnessPolicy defines the TTL-based freshness check.

questions.question: What happens to saved repositories when a complete owner repository list no longer contains them?

expected_locations.note: Complete snapshots mark saved repositories missing and delete unsaved repositories.
DAO queries implement missing-saved marking and unsaved deletion.

questions.question: How does the app save or unsave a repository from the repository detail screen?

expected_locations.note: RepositoryViewModel toggles the saved state for the current repository.
RepositoryCatalog persists saved and unsaved state inside a transaction.

questions.question: How are GitHub HTTP errors mapped to DevPulse errors like rate limited, not found, and server error?

expected_locations.note: ErrorMapping converts IO, Retrofit HTTP, SQL, and unknown failures into DevPulseError values.

questions.question: How does the search screen validate and submit a GitHub username?

expected_locations.note: SearchRoute trims, validates, stores errors, and submits the normalized username.
The GitHub username regex and validation messages live here.
